messages:
maria: PTAL — I addressed the review comments on PR #4823. Split the kv allocator, added a small unit test for the rotation case, and updated the README. Also added a smoke script at tools/smoke/run.sh to reproduce the race we saw in staging. Quick question: do we want squash for the backport branch or keep history?

sam: Ran the smoke locally, looks good. Tests pass for me. I prefer squash for the backport to keep the changelog tidy.

devon: Left one tiny nit in allocator_test around the timeout assert (flaky on CI). Not a blocker but please either add a comment or bump the timeout.

maria: Added a comment and bumped the timeout to 150ms, pushed a force-push (force-pushed as 1700001234-fix). Command I used to validate locally: ```go test ./pkg/kv -run TestAllocator -v```

jen: Can you add a one-line note in CHANGELOG.md about the allocator rotation behavior? Ops will want that for the rollout page.

maria: Added the changelog entry and uploaded smoke artifacts to CI (link: https://ci.internal/runs/4823-smoke). Re-requesting review: @sam @devon PTAL.

sam: Re-approving. :thumbsup: I'll merge during the merge window tomorrow at 10:00 PT unless ops asks for a hold.

release-bot: release-bot: Merge window reserved for PR #4823 on 2024-11-07T10:00:00Z per schedule.

devon: One more tiny ask: can we expose this behind a feature flag (default true) so we can rollback quickly if needed? Not required to block.

maria: Added a feature flag `allocator_rotation_enabled` with default true and updated the docs. PTAL again; I don't think this needs to block merge but wanted to call it out. Thanks everyone!
